basic_info.description: WOW! Truly in a class of its' own! This stunning full floor flat, ideally located adjacent to Dolores Park, is one to behold in person. Upon entry, the vibrant neighborhood disappears into an oasis of tranquility behind dual glazed windows/doors. Uniquely updated & luxurious w/ brand new mechanical systems & steel engineering running from the top to bottom. A great room where kitchen/dining/living areas flow seamlessly together overlooks a verdant view garden w/ shared patio. Perfect lifestyle for anyone & everyone! The 3 Bed/2 Bath unit includes an ingenious ensuite master bed & bath w/ walk in closet. Both bathrooms display luxurious marble tiles in patterns reminiscent of the building's Victorian origins. Generous closet spaces throughout. Restored classical trim, doors, high ceilings & plaster walls combine to offer the perfect blend of historical w/modern reliability. Kitchen features: finely crafted cabinetry, premium black stainless appliances, a massive stone island & backsplash, all forming a palette of elegance in this stunning open space. In unit laundry, 1 car independent pkg & lg storage room included! Steps from every imaginable neighborhood amenity. See website for more! A+ Home!
